description:
Demo journey: log in, find the customer, then open every profile tab and section,
  waiting for each one to finish loading before moving on. Read-only: nothing is saved.

elements.name: SC-C360.E2E An agent finds a customer and explores every tab and section of the profile

steps.name: I am logged into Salesforce as a sales agent
I search for the customer "customerByMobile"
the first search result is a recommended Account
the first account result shows the status of "customerByMobile"
I open the first customer in the search results
the customer record opens in its own workspace tab
the customer header shows the mobile number and status of "customerByMobile"
the customer record shows the record tabs of "customerByMobile"
each product section shows as many accounts as its count
every closed account shows a zero or N/A balance
the account "activeMoneyAccount" shows a positive balance
I open the "Details" tab
the tab content shows "^Personal Details$"
I open the "Customer Attributes" tab
every customer attribute of "customerByMobile" has a true or false value
I open the "Cases" tab
the cases list shows the columns of "customerByMobile"
the cases list contains cases with the statuses "OPEN, Closed"
I open the "Transactions" tab
the transactions account selector lists every account from the product sections
I select the account "activeMoneyAccount" for transactions
only transactions of the account "activeMoneyAccount" are listed
I select the account "closedMoneyAccount" for transactions
only transactions of the account "closedMoneyAccount" are listed
I select the account "activeMoneyAccount" for transactions
I filter the transactions with "creditsOnly"
every listed transaction matches the filter "creditsOnly"
I clear the transaction filter
I filter the transactions with "amount3000To6000"
every listed transaction matches the filter "amount3000To6000"
I clear the transaction filter
I view the details of the first transaction
the transaction details show their sections and key fields
I can close the transaction details
I open the "Cards" tab
card numbers are masked except for the last four digits
the card menu offers the expected actions
I open the "Documents" tab
the tab content shows "^Documents \(\d+\)$"
I open the "Beneficiaries" tab
the tab content shows "^Payees \(\d+\)$"
I open the "Statements" tab
the tab content shows "^Select Account$"
I open the "Devices" tab
the tab content shows "^deviceId$"
I open the "Orders" tab
the tab content shows "^Customer Onboarding$"
I open the "Applications" tab
the tab content shows "^Applications \(\d+\)$"
I open the "Engagement Interactions" tab
I open the "Customer Markers" tab
the tab content shows "^Custom Markers \(\d+\)$"
I open the "Details" tab
the customer header shows the mobile number and status of "customerByMobile"

name: Customer 360 end-to-end walkthrough (OM Bank console)
